title: A nowrap run must fit its container at 200% text and WCAG text spacing
trigger: PR #619 (S06) wrapped Chinese heading words in white-space: nowrap spans and claimed four glyphs fit any heading line. A red-team review asked for 200% text and text-spacing proof; the new test found the home product row's status word overflowing a 46px name column at 320px.
root_cause: The no-overflow claim was reasoned from viewport width only. A rem-sized icon in the same grid row grew with the text and squeezed the text column, so a container narrower than the reasoning assumed existed only under text zoom.
rule: Any white-space: nowrap run in a width-constrained container needs a test at 320px with 200% text and WCAG 1.4.12 text spacing proving the run fits its container.
reuse_boundary: Browser-facing UI that adds nowrap (or another unbreakable run) inside text that sits in a grid or flex row with siblings. Not for single-line controls that already scroll or truncate by design.

guard.path: tests/e2e/ux-s06-cjk-heading-breaks.spec.ts + tests/e2e/a11y-text-zoom-nowrap.spec.ts (site-wide: 9 routes × 4 locales at 320px, 200% text, 1.4.12 spacing)
guard.negative_proof: Reverting the fixed 48px icon to 3rem fails the test on /zh/ and /zh-hant/ ("开发", "開發"); a 1em heading is reported by the guard's own negative-proof test. Run locally in Chromium on 2026-10-16; Firefox and WebKit run it in CI.
guard.notes: 2026-10-16 WP-06: 27/37 routes passed in Chromium; the 10 failures (product [slug] headers, zh/zh-hant About labels) were fixed in #631 and are pinned by tests/e2e/text-zoom-reflow.spec.ts. 2026-10-17: all 37 routes pass in Chromium. The detector also reports a nowrap run that fits its ancestor but crosses the viewport edge; removing that branch fails its negative-proof test.
